extracted.intended_audience: public relations professionals, corporate communicators, and brands seeking press release distribution and amplification
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and service-oriented criteria for creating, optimizing, and distributing press releases to maximize visibility, discoverability, and impact using a commercial distribution platform (PR Newswire).

rubrics_metrics.name: True Multichannel Amplification™
rubrics_metrics.description: Extend your story’s reach and distribute your news simultaneously across multiple channels for maximum impact, increased visibility and demonstrate ROI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribute a press release simultaneously across multiple channels (newswire, social, email, third-party outlets) to increase impact and to be able to measure and demonstrate return on investment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unmatched Discoverability
rubrics_metrics.description: The industry leader in domain authority and web traffic, PRNewswire.com delivers a minimum 2x more search visibility and greater reach for your story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize mechanisms that improve search visibility and leverage platforms with strong domain authority and web traffic; use the distribution service to increase SEO-driven discovery (claim: minimum 2x search visibility).

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation in One Platform (Unified Planning, Creation, Distribution, Reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: The only place for unified planning, creation, distribution and reporting in one AI-enhanced platform, purpose-built for communicators to maximize results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an integrated workflow (plan → create → distribute → report) and AI tools to streamline campaign building and to ensure consistent metrics across stages of a campaign.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximum Visibility (Scale of Distribution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reach 500K+ media outlets, newsrooms and influencers worldwide through the industry’s largest, most trusted multimedia distribution network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select distribution channels and packages that provide broad reach to a large number of outlets and influencers when the goal is widespread exposure; measure which outlet types are reached.

rubrics_metrics.name: Most Trusted Source (Credibility & Authority)
rubrics_metrics.description: For 70+ years, brands have relied on PR Newswire as the most credible, authoritative news source recognized by journalists and media worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage recognized, longstanding distribution sources to lend credibility to releases; journalists’ recognition of the source increases pickup and trustworthiness of the content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premium Service and Guidance (Editorial Support & SEO Best Practices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Expert editors averaging 12+ years’ experience provide 24/7/365 support, content guidance and SEO best practices with 99.9% accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use professional editorial review and SEO guidance to optimize headlines, ledes, keywords, and structure; take advantage of around-the-clock editorial assistance to reduce errors and improve search performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create+ — Turn One Story into Multiple Campaign Assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Create+ instantly generates campaign content like blog posts, snapshot videos and media pitches, helping extend your story beyond the press release, across more channels and audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repurpose a single press release into multiple asset types (blog posts, short videos, pitch copy) to increase reach across channels and tailor messaging to different audiences and formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan Module — Research, Brainstorm and Build Campaigns
rubrics_metrics.description: Research, brainstorm and build better campaigns with the new Plan module. Discover trending industry news, then craft a complete campaign strategy and promotion plan in minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use planning tools to surface trends and competitive context before drafting; create a strategy and promotion plan that aligns timing, targeting, and assets for the release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Release Score and Actionable Insights (Pre-distribution Evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Quickly enhance or craft high quality press releases, in your brand voice. Powered by AI and trained on decades of performance data and best practices, use the Press Release Score and actionable insights to strengthen your content before it goes out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run content through an AI-driven scoring/evaluation tool to identify weaknesses and receive concrete suggestions (headline, angle, keywords, tone) prior to distribution to improve engagement and effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia Distribution and Use of Visual Assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Industry’s largest, most trusted multimedia distribution network (implied emphasis on multimedia in distribution).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include multimedia elements (images, videos, snapshots) in releases and use a platform that supports multimedia distribution to boost engagement and coverage; leverage snapshot videos and other visual assets generated via Create+.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeting, Monitoring and Measurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Header claim: 'press release distribution, targeting, monitoring and marketing' (platform provides targeting and monitoring capabilities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target distribution to relevant beats, outlets, and influencers and use monitoring/analytics to track pickup, engagement, and ROI (demonstrate results and refine future campaigns).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting & Demonstrable ROI
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements referencing demonstrating ROI and unified reporting as part of the platform capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect and review distribution and audience metrics (search visibility, web traffic, pickups, media impressions) to quantify the impact of a release and inform future strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of AI and Search Intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: Platform is AI-enhanced and—per acquisition note—integrated with search intelligence and GenAI monitoring (Trajaan acquisition).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate AI tools and search intelligence for trend discovery, monitoring conversations, and improving content relevance; leverage GenAI monitoring for ongoing audience insights post-distribution.
